preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 1000.
The dimensions of the matrices R and C must be between 2 and 1000.
The integer X must be at least 2 and at most the minimum of R and C.

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= A[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(R) for j in range(C)) and all(-10**9 <= B[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(R) for j in range(C))
preconditions.description: All elements of matrices A and B must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
The sum of R and C over all test cases must not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'Yes' or 'No' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any((A[i][j] - B[i][j]) % X == 0 for i in range(R) for j in range(C))
postconditions.description: For each element, the difference between A and B must be divisible by X.

postconditions.expression: sum(A[i][j] for i in range(R) for j in range(C)) % X == sum(B[i][j] for i in range(R) for j in range(C)) % X
postconditions.description: The sum of elements in A and B must have the same remainder when divided by X.
